candidate.definition_en: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body inactive.
candidate.explanation_ar: ينام، يعني يرتاح ويغمض عينه ويفصل عن العالم.

senses.definition_en: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body inactive.
senses.explanation_ar: ينام، يعني يرتاح ويغمض عينه ويفصل عن العالم.

examples: I couldn't sleep because of the noise.
You should sleep for eight hours every night.
candidate.mnemonic: لما تكون تعبان لازم تـ 'Sleep' عشان ترتاح.
